title: LuaLaTeX page reference lookup experiments

fixture.compile_path: write_latex_pdf production helper; complete multipass compilation

variants.name: per-target-page-number-cache
variants.role: temporary candidate; not added to production source

variants.name: guarded-refcount-page-number
variants.role: temporary candidate; not added to production source
variants.undefined_reference_behavior: falls back to pageref* so the existing undefined-reference warning path remains active

decision.reason: The cache variant is effectively neutral at N=100. The guarded refcount variant has one N=100 timing and no repeated same-session timing pair; its apparent difference is not sufficient evidence of a speedup.
decision.retained_behavior: Keep pageref* in gfbpagelink, including its native unresolved-reference diagnostics.

limitations: One full compilation per N=100 variant; no stable performance percentage can be claimed.
Synthetic data only; the N=100 timing fixture had no media.
PDF byte sizes vary slightly between builds even when extracted text and structural counts match.
